reuse.why: Reuses findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and syncAccount, extracts clearBankLink from unlinkAccount and generalises the Akahu download into a shared single-account downloader, though the Fintegra link function re-copies the link body instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: The link rules live in one prepareBankAccountLink helper called by every provider, but linkFintegraAccount is a near-verbatim copy of linkAkahuAccount (~60 lines), adding a sixth copy of the link body.

placement.why: Link guard and unlink reset sit in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, download logic in sync.ts and the base path in server-config.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the four requested behaviours plus tests; nothing unrelated is touched.

maintainability.why: One guard function for all providers and a shared downloader are easy to own; the extra copied link function is the main cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers route through prepareBankAccountLink; unlinkAccount and takeover share clearBankLink; Akahu and Fintegra share downloadSingleAccountBankSyncTransactions.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount in app.ts is an overt copy of linkAkahuAccount, not disguised; the other shared pieces are genuinely shared.

abstraction_drift.where: prepareBankAccountLink gained the replaceExistingLink parameter (step 4) and a general closed-account check (step 3), applied uniformly to all callers; no provider-specific branches inside it and no caller bypasses it.
